Kerja Raya terhadap pembuatan perintah itu:

ROAD T RANSPORT  (P ROHIBITION  OF U SE OF R OAD)
(FEDERAL  R OADS ) O RDER  2012
WHEREAS  by P.U. (B) 591/2011 published on 1 December 2011, notice was
given of the intention to make an order under subsections 70(1) and (2) of
the Road Transport Act 1987 [ Act 333]:
 A ND WHEREAS  no objection was received by the Minister of Works against
the making of such order:
 N OW THEREFORE , in exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 70(1)
and (2) of the Act, the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration
the matters referred to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following
order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use
of Road) (Federal Roads) Order 2012.
 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 16 December 2011.
Prohibition
2. The driving of vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1)
of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise
than on the routes specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, for the period
specified in column (3) of the First Schedule is prohibited.

AKTA PENGANGKUTAN JALAN 1987
PERINTAH  H AD L AJU T EMPATAN (J ALAN  P ERSEKUTUAN )
(LARANGAN  M ASA T ERTENTU ) 2012
PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 69(2) Akta Pengangkutan
Jalan 1987 [Akta 333 ], Menteri membuat perintah yang berikut:
Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Tempatan (Jalan
Persekutuan) (Larangan Masa Tertentu) 2012.
 (2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa mulai 16 Januari 2012 hingga 30 Januari 2012.
Larangan
2. (1) Pemanduan kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang lebih daripada
80 km/j di atas semua jalan Persekutuan di Malaysia, selain jalan yang dinyatakan
dalam Jadual Pertama Perintah Had Laju Tempatan (Jalan Persekutuan) (Malaysia
Barat) 1992 [P .U. (A) 462/1991], dilarang.
 (2) Larangan yang disebut dalam subperenggan (1) hendaklah terhenti
berkuat kuasa apabila habis tempoh Perintah ini.
Dibuat 16 Januari 2012
[KKR.PUU.110-1/8/1 Jld. 2; PN(PU 2)460/LXV]
 D ATUK S ERI S HAZIMAN  BIN ABU M ANSOR
 Menteri Kerja Raya
ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987
LOCAL  S PEED  L IMIT  (F EDERAL  R OADS ) (S PECIFIED  T IME P ROHIBITION )
ORDER  2012
IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport
Act 1987 [Act 333 ], the Minister makes the following order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Local Speed Limit (Federal Roads)
(Specified Time Prohibition) Order 2012 .
 (2) This Order has effect from 16 January 2012 to 30 January 2012.
P.U. (A) 16.
Prohibition
2. (1) The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than 80 km/h over all
Federal roads in Malaysia, other than the roads specified in the First Schedule
of the Local Speed Limit (Federal Roads) (West Malaysia) Order 1992
[P .U. (A) 462/1991], is prohibited.
 (2) The prohibition mentioned in subparagraph (1) shall cease to have
effect upon the expiry of this Order.
Made 16 January 2012
[KKR.PUU.110-1/8/1 Jld. 2; PN(PU 2)460/LXV]
 D ATUK S ERI S HAZIMAN  BIN ABU M ANSOR
 Minister of Works
P.U. (A) 17.
AKTA PENGANGKUTAN JALAN 1987
PERINTAH  H AD L AJU K EBANGSAAN  (P EMBERHENTIAN  S EMENTARA ) 2012
PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 69(1) Akta Pengangkutan
Jalan 1987 [Akta 333 ], Menteri membuat perintah yang berikut:
Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan
(Pemberhentian Sementara) 2012.
 (2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa mulai 16 Januari 2012 hingga 30 Januari 2012.
Pemberhentian Sementara
2. (1) Subperenggan 2(1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [ P .U. (A) 18/1989]
yang memperuntukkan had laju 90 kilometer sejam bagi semua jalan
di Malaysia, selain jalan yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual kepada Perintah Had
Laju Kebangsaan 1989, hendaklah terhenti berkuat kuasa bagi tempoh mulai
16 Januari 2012 hingga 30 Januari 2012.
 (2) Apabila habis tempoh Perintah ini, subperenggan 2(1) Perintah Had
Laju Kebangsaan 1989 hendaklah berkuat kuasa seolah-olah Perintah ini tidak
dibuat.
Dibuat 13 Januari 2012
[KP.PUU/W/BD/9; PN(PU 2)460/LXV]
 D ATO' S ERI K ONG C HO H A
 Menteri Pengangkutan
P.U. (A) 16-17.
ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987
NATIONAL  S PEED  L IMIT  (T EMPORARY  C ESSATION ) O RDER  2012
IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport
Act 1987 [Act 333 ], the Minister makes the following order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Temporary
Cessation) Order 2012.
 (2) This Order has effect from 16 January 2012 to 30 January 2012.
Temporary Cessation
2. (1) Subparagraph 2(1) of the National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P .U. (A) 18/1989]
which provides the speed limit of 90 kilometers per hour for all roads in Malaysia
other than the roads described in the Schedule to the National Speed Limit
Order 1989, shall cease to have effect for the period from 16 January 2012
to 30 January 2012.
 (2) Upon the expiry of this Order, subparagraph 2(1) of the National Speed
Limit Order 1989 shall have effect as if this Order has not been made.
Made 13 January 2012
[KP.PUU/W/BD/9; PN(PU 2)460/LXV]
 D ATO' S ERI K ONG C HO H A
 Minister of Transport
